justification: Look, I didn't want to touch anything, I never want to touch anything, but Worthy's got no game, zero points, the Chiefs just vanish off the schedule like my FAAB disappears every time I actually need it -- that's not a gut call, that's a bye week, even I know you can't bench a man who isn't playing.
